description: This file defines a validation rule class for checking the aspect ratio of images in the OrangeHRM system. The class is used to validate image input data, ensuring that the aspect ratio matches a specified value within a certain tolerance, except for SVG images which are exempt from aspect ratio validation.

classes.name: ImageAspectRatio
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether an image's aspect ratio matches a specified value within a certain tolerance, with special handling for SVG images.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validation rule with a target aspect ratio.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the input data to confirm the image has the correct aspect ratio or is an SVG.
